recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle - and covered two serious milestone (pay-in-phases) money bugs found and fixed on day one. Days 2-4 (June 26, 2026) chased a WhatsApp notification bug through three layers, shipped a 'resume TXN-CODE' cross-platform command, and fixed a milestone phase-numbering bug in emails. Day 5 (also June 26, 2026) swapped placeholder payment icons for real brand logos, broke and then fixed the platform-fee display in the same cleanup pass. Day 6 (June 27, 2026) shipped a huge solo admin-dashboard expansion in one sitting - ten new back-office pages - then firefought a build-breaking TypeScript error and an admin auto-logout bug from a login cookie scoped to the wrong domain, fixed via localStorage JWT. Day 7 (June 30, 2026) was a consolidation day: redesigned all 26 admin pages into one consistent navy design system, wired the whole admin panel into Supabase Realtime so it updates live instead of needing refreshes, found and fixed yet another admin login bug (wrong API URL bypassing the Next.js proxy), and wrote the project's first-ever automated test suite (66 tests covering login and admin routes). Day 8 (also June 30, 2026) polished all 8 admin pages to a consistent look, rebuilt the settings page from 3 placeholder fields into 44 real controls across 7 sections (fees, payouts, KYC, disputes, referrals, security), then discovered on first real test that almost none of those 44 fields actually saved - the API only recognized a handful, booleans turned to NaN, and percentages were off by 100x - all fixed same day. Day 9 (also June 30, 2026) fully rebuilt the admin analytics page to match a reference design - funnel drop-off chart, revenue/growth/platform tabs - then caught and fixed a font-consistency bug across the whole page the same day. Day 10 (also June 30, 2026) shipped badge cards - composited trust-badge images sent through all six bots when a user earns a milestone - then chased two same-day bugs: a locked-silhouette rendering order bug, and a production 500 caused by forgetting to rebuild the API dist after a code fix. Next chapter picks back up with the rest of that day's badge and reviews work.
